# Loopwork

> Loopwork is a small publishing studio based in Poland. We turn an Instagram creator's best teaching posts into a designed eBook that their audience can buy, and we set up the shop, checkout and payouts on Whop.

How it works: we read the creator's posts, write a free first chapter, then draft the full book with AI tools and edit every page by hand against the creator's own content. Nothing is published until the creator approves it. The creator's content stays theirs.

Pricing: pay nothing upfront and split sales 50/50 (our pick for a first book), or pay a one-time $199 per book (for a creator's first 3 books, if they start by 31 December 2026) and keep every sale. The first chapter is free either way. On the $199 option, if the creator doesn't approve the book, we refund the half they paid upfront.

## Pages

- [Home](https://loopworkbooks.com/): what we do, how it works, the deal, FAQ, and the form to get a free chapter
- [Our books](https://loopworkbooks.com/books): the books we have published, with links to each book's page
- [Privacy](https://loopworkbooks.com/privacy): what we collect and why

## Books

- [The Overtired Dog](https://whop.com/loopworkbooks/the-overtired-dog) by dog trainer Kris Downey: how to spot over-arousal early and help a dog switch off. $19.
- [The Small Steps Home Reset](https://whop.com/unclutter-it/the-small-steps-home-reset) by professional organizer Bridget Stralko: a step-by-step plan to declutter and reset a home in small steps. $20.
